violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Food employee was observed putting on gloves without washing her hands. Employee also did not wash her hands after taking a drink. Hands should be washed before putting on gloves and after eating or drinking.

Preventing contamination by employees. — --Employee observed using same pair of single-use gloves for more than one task. Observed food employee complete multiple tasks with the same gloves. Gloves should be changed after each task and when exiting the food area.--Employee's single-use gloves were not discarded after being damaged or soiled. Observed food employee with gloved hands touch her face and clothing and did not change gloves. Gloves should be changed after touching personal items. **Discussed the need for gloves only when handling ready to eat items.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Breakfast bar backsplash near the juice dispenser and the oatmeal bar was found damaged. Backsplash should be repaired and maintained in good repair.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Ceiling was found dirty near the vents. This should be cleaned and maintained clean.
